must_pass_policy: All must-pass checks must be true before R1. Repair mechanical failures without consuming a subjective round; otherwise mark blocked.

must_pass.evidence: timestamped transcript hash and positive cue count
start, transition, stable, and exit frame evidence
declared Demo files and default fixture assets
project math or contract test log
lint, validate, and inspect exit zero
nonempty MP4, SHA-256, ffprobe stream metadata
one final candidate and R2/final hash equality

anchors.1: Only resembles the surface style; taught causal mechanism is absent.
anchors.3: Core mechanism exists but one important causal relation is weak or ambiguous.
anchors.5: Every claimed tutorial mechanism is visible and tied to located evidence.

anchors.1: Transitions, staggering, or settling contradict the observed timing.
anchors.3: Main phases are recognizable but pacing or easing differs materially.
anchors.5: Entry, transition, settle, hold, and exit relationships match the motion evidence.

anchors.1: Focus is unclear and layers compete.
anchors.3: Primary focus reads, with minor depth or contrast issues.
anchors.5: Hierarchy, depth, typography, and framing guide attention intentionally.

anchors.1: Aspect ratio, crop, or rights do not fit the composition.
anchors.3: Assets are usable but selection or crop is generic.
anchors.5: Authorized assets reinforce the composition and remain safe across motion.

anchors.1: Full playback exposes dead time, collisions, or abrupt discontinuities.
anchors.3: The piece is coherent with one noticeable rhythm problem.
anchors.5: The entire MP4 holds attention and every phase has a deliberate duration.

anchors.1: Depends on private files or undeclared machine state.
anchors.3: Build is mostly reproducible with minor undocumented assumptions.
anchors.5: A clean checkout checks and renders with fixtures; private overrides are optional and ignored.

round_rules.r1: Review the entire draft MP4 hash, identify timestamped issues, and choose exactly one highest-impact subjective top_fix.
round_rules.revise: Change only top_fix.dimension and freeze already-correct dimensions; render a new MP4 hash.
round_rules.r2: Independently review the new MP4 hash, record timestamped residuals, set top_fix to null, and stop.
round_rules.finalize: If must-pass is green, use completed at score >= 80, otherwise completed_with_residuals. Point final.json at exactly the R2-reviewed hash and never rerender afterward.
